remarks: Price Improved - Limited Time Opportunity  Welcome to 100 Hope Street, Unit 10 - a bright and spacious four-level townhouse offering over 2,000 square feet of flexible living space in one of Stamford's most convenient locations. Now offered at $599,000 this is a compelling opportunity for buyers seeking space and commuter convenience.  Designed with distinct living zones across four levels, the layout provides exceptional flexibility. The main level features a kitchen with stainless steel appliances, a formal dining room, and a sunken living room with sliders to a private balcony.  Upstairs, the vaulted primary suite includes an en-suite bath, private laundry, and a private deck. Two additional bedrooms and a full hall bath complete the upper and fourth level.  The finished lower level offers a separate entrance, full bath, secondary laundry, and flexible space ideal for guests, home office, recreation, or extended living. Storage is abundant with a walk-up attic and multiple closets.  Convenient to Glenbrook Station (~0.8 miles), Stamford Station (~1.9 miles), and Springdale Station (~1.9 miles). The pet-friendly community includes an inground pool, playground, visitor parking, and one reserved space.  Smart value in today's Stamford market.
